description: Makes one day or a whole range unavailable, for one unit or (without unit_id) for all units: no bookings can be made on those nights, online, by the venue or on connected channels. A closed day means nobody can stay that night. Existing bookings on those days are not cancelled; they are listed in the answer. For one day, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

reason.description: Optional, only the venue sees it, e.g. "Holiday" or "Family visit".

to.description: Last closed night (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

unit_id.description: Leave out to close all units.

name: close_days
title: Close days
